fields.label: Slot is empty (new)
fields.description: Non-zero means the game shows this slot as an empty, new file.

fields.label: Play time
fields.description: Wii clock ticks; HD uses the same rate (checked in Sky Recomp).

fields.label: Saved at
fields.description: Wii clock ticks since 2000-01-01 00:00, local time.

hd.description: Unix time (seconds since 1970), shown in UTC.

fields.label: Night
fields.description: night_t1. Sleeping to night sets it together with the t3 night flag and story flag 737 (checked in Sky Recomp).

fields.label: Heart capacity
fields.description: Stored in quarter hearts: 18 hearts (the maximum) = 72.

fields.label: Current health
fields.description: Saves often hold more than the capacity here; the game appears to clamp it on load.

fields.label: Unknown hearts value
fields.description: Unused by the game according to the decompilation; 24 in every sample seen.

fields.label: Load-screen location
fields.description: Index of the area name shown on the load screen (file_area_index).

groups.title: Spawn (t1)
groups.description: Where the file loads. The decompilation names these *_t1/_t2/_t3; t1 and t3 matched in every sample save.

fields.label: Stage
fields.description: Folder name of the stage, e.g. F000 for Skyloft.

fields.label: Entrance load flag
fields.description: 1: the file loads at the entrance above instead of the saved position (autosaves made on entering an area use it). With it set, stage, room and entrance alone are enough to place Link; checked in Sky Recomp by loading into Flooded Faron Woods (F103, entrance 0) with no position.

groups.title: Spawn (t2)
groups.description: Holds the last Surface region in the sample saves (empty before the first dive).

groups.title: Spawn (t3)
groups.description: Matched t1 in every sample save.

fields.label: Night
fields.description: night_t3; follows the t1 night flag.

groups.title: Game state
groups.description: Names from the decompilation; the observations are from real saves.

fields.label: Live scene-flag area
fields.description: scene_flag_index: which area's scene flags were in use when the file was saved. The game rewrites it on every save (Lanayru Caves use Lanayru Gorge's).

fields.label: Areas visited (bitmask)
fields.description: field_0x07BC in the decompilation. Bits appear as new regions are reached: 0 Skyloft, 1 Sealed Grounds/Faron, 2–3 Skyview, 4 Ancient Cistern, 5 Eldin, 6 Fire Sanctuary, 7–8 Lanayru, 9 Lanayru Gorge (set by its intro cutscene; checked in Sky Recomp), 10–11 Sand Sea.

fields.label: Saved from a save prompt?
fields.description: field_0x53b5 in the decompilation. 1 in saves made at the prompt after a dungeon and in HD autosaves, 0 in statue saves; not confirmed.

fields.label: Sky Keep room layout
fields.description: The 3×3 grid of Sky Keep rooms (skykeep_puzzle); 0xFF is the empty space.

fields.label: Potion timers
fields.description: Time left on active potions: air, air+, stamina, stamina+, guardian, guardian+.

fields.label: Game ID
fields.description: Shared by all three slots. Must match the game disc you play, and Dolphin looks for the save in the folder named after it.
